orbit-viking1-hirise.method: End of the Lander leader line in NASA's annotated PIA01881_fig1.jpg, the same pixels as the plain release.
orbit-viking1-hirise.scale: MAP_SCALE 0.25 m in https://hirise-pds.lpl.arizona.edu/PDS/RDR/PSP/ORB_001500_001599/PSP_001521_2025/PSP_001521_2025_RED.LBL, east to west at 22.27° N. The figure matches the RED browse image at 0.255 m per pixel, so it is at full resolution.

orbit-viking2-hirise.method: End of the Lander leader line in NASA's annotated PIA01882_fig1.jpg, the same pixels as the plain release.
orbit-viking2-hirise.scale: No scale bar. The figure has too little relief to match against the browse image, so its pixel scale could not be checked.

orbit-spirit-hirise.method: Brightest pixel in the image, where the HiRISE caption of ESP_021925_1650 says Spirit is the brightest spot.
orbit-spirit-hirise.scale: No scale bar. The HiRISE page does not give the scale of this cut and it could not be matched to the browse image.

orbit-opportunity-hirise.method: Bright hardware at the center of the crater the HiRISE caption of ESP_050177_1780 names as Eagle crater, where it says the lander rests.
orbit-opportunity-hirise.scale: No scale bar. The HiRISE page does not give the scale of this cut and it could not be matched to the browse image.

orbit-phoenix-2008.method: The feature the PIA22223 caption names as the lander (top). Figures 1 and 2 line up to within 1 px.
orbit-phoenix-2008.scale: MAP_SCALE 0.25 m in https://hirise-pds.lpl.arizona.edu/PDS/RDR/PSP/ORB_009200_009299/PSP_009290_2485/PSP_009290_2485_RED.LBL, polar stereographic, at 68.22° N. The caption says each figure is about 300 m wide, which the 1286 px width at this scale matches.

orbit-phoenix-2017.method: The feature the PIA22223 caption names as the lander (top). Figures 1 and 2 line up to within 1 px.
orbit-phoenix-2017.scale: MAP_SCALE 0.25 m in https://hirise-pds.lpl.arizona.edu/PDS/RDR/ESP/ORB_053400_053499/ESP_053451_2485/ESP_053451_2485_RED.LBL, polar stereographic, at 68.22° N. The caption says each figure is about 300 m wide, which the 1286 px width at this scale matches.

orbit-insight-2018.method: The bright spot with two dark round solar arrays, the InSight lander in the HiRISE full resolution hardware cutout and in the labeled release ESP_058005_1845-labels.
orbit-insight-2018.scale: MAP_SCALE 0.25 m in https://hirise-pds.lpl.arizona.edu/PDS/RDR/ESP/ORB_058000_058099/ESP_058005_1845/ESP_058005_1845_RED.LBL, a full resolution cutout, scaled to 1400 px wide on this site.

orbit-insight-2024.method: The two dark round solar arrays inside the faded blast mark in PIA26515, NASA's HiRISE view of InSight.
orbit-insight-2024.scale: The 100 m bar NASA printed on PIA26515, 330 px long. The bar is cropped out of the view on this site.
